title: Psychiatry
excerpt: Confidential mental health consultations, psychotherapy support, medication management, and follow-up coordinated with primary care physicians.
body: Hope Clinic structures each specialty visit around evidence-based workflows: licensed intake nurses capture vitals and screening questionnaires, clinicians review medication interactions, and coordinators queue follow-ups before patients reach the lobby.

Referral packets—including imaging CDs, pathology PDFs, and employer return-to-work forms—are consolidated into HIPAA-secure links you can forward to caregivers or schools without duplicating photocopies.
Same-day escalation paths exist whenever red-flag symptoms emerge during triage; after-hours voicemail automatically pages the on-call hospitalist liaison attached to your care team.

title: Dental
excerpt: Preventive dentistry, periodontal maintenance, fillings, restorative care, whitening consults, and referral handoffs to orthodontic or oral-surgery colleagues.
body: Our dental wing pairs general dentists with periodontic and oral-surgery liaisons so complex cases never stall between providers. Digital radiographs load chairside for immediate co-planning with patients and parents.

Preventive visits bundle caries-risk scoring, fluoride varnish when indicated, and sleep-apnea screening questionnaires for adult snorers. Invisalign consults and implant planning slots book on alternating afternoons to keep sterilization turnover predictable.
Patients receive itemized treatment plans with insurance-friendly ADA codes before any elective cosmetic work begins, minimizing surprise invoices after multi-visit veneer sequences.
